product_metadata.title: Sunbeam Royal Ultra Admiral Blue Heated Blanket - Twin
features: Easy to use electric blanket with digital controller, with 12 heat settings and 12-hour selectable auto-shut off function for peace of mind
Soft, comfy and cozy royal ultra for ideal warmth and comfort, elegant admiral blue color
Perfect for layering and pre-heating bed sheets on chilly nights
Machine washable and dryer safe for easy care, 100% Polyester
description: Sleep better with the Sunbeam Royal Ultra Heated Twin Size Blanket and beat those winter blues. Indulge yourself with its comfy and cozy royal ultra material, wrapping you in luxurious warmth all night long. Easy to use detachable controller with 12 heat settings to choose from and a 12-hour auto-shut off feature for peace of mind. This stylish blanket comes in elegant color options that are sure to compliment any decor. Remove the controller and place the blanket into the washer and dryer for easy maintenance.
